title: Insane Karen Goes Ballistic On Police After Getting Wasted With Her Kid
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On April 7th, 2023. Officers received multiple 911 calls in regards a highly intoxicated woman who was yelling at her kid and causing a major disturbance on a bridge. The officers tried to get her to calm down however she refused to listen, and was ultimately placed under arrest. It didn’t end  there though, she escaped from the back of the cop car to the front and started causing even more havoc to the point where she had to be subdued in restraints. She kicked multiple officers and even urinated on herself. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
